BiblicalUsage: Pithron is the interpretation of a dream. Joseph said, Do not interpretations belong to God, in Genesis 40:8, and gave the meaning: the three branches are three days, in Genesis 40:12. The butler remembered the interpretation of his dream in Genesis 41:11.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe interpretations belong to God, and the man who knows that is the man God uses.
